

### Install

**Firefox:** install from [addons.mozilla.org](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/x-blocker/). It updates automatically. A new version can take a few days to appear there while Mozilla reviews it.

**Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera** (not in the Chrome Web Store):
1. Download `x-blocker-chrome-{version}.zip` below and extract it to a folder you will keep.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and switch on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the extracted folder.

To update, replace the folder's contents with the new version and click the reload icon on the extension's card. Your settings and data are kept as long as you use the same folder.
